about_the_game:
The Game

In this dark fortress, you take on the role of a nameless prisoner, venturing through rooms filled with monsters and deadly threats. Every death is permanent, but your choices will leave their mark on the prisoners that come after you. Decide how to face each challenge, balancing combat, risky alliances, and mysterious upgrades. But remember: the path is long, and every step could bring you closer to freedom—or to an even darker fate.

Features

  • Choose from 9 unique classes and equip shields, weapons, armor, potions, and anything else that might aid you in your struggle.

  • Face off against monsters, gather loot, or savor rare moments of rest between challenges.

  • Prepare for fearsome bosses, each with their own unique traits and obstacles to overcome.

  • Uncover the story of the Sorcerer King, his allies, and your fellow prisoners—and maybe, in the process, learn something about yourself.

    The WorldThe Fortress tells the tale of nameless prisoners captured during the Sorcerer King’s expansionist wars and locked away in his shadowy citadel. In a grim medieval world, the prisoners fight for survival and freedom, braving monsters and perils as they make their way through endless catacombs, underground forges, and treacherous courts. The ultimate goal? To reach the highest tower and defeat the Sorcerer King. The road is paved with dangers and foes but also unexpected opportunities...

    Along the way, you'll meet dubious allies: vampire merchants, fallen abbots, and other sinister figures, each hiding secrets and ulterior motives. Their aid could prove vital—but at what cost? Managing the balance between their demands and your own survival is up to you. Every choice might lead to salvation—or death. But no matter; there’s always another prisoner ready to try escaping the Fortress.

  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000
  • DirectX: Version 10

short_description: The Fortress is a dark fantasy dungeon crawler with turn-based combat, mixing strategy and risk. Choose a class, delve into cursed chambers, roll dice to fight brutal enemies, and grab loot. Face tough choices, survive epic bosses, and fight to escape... or fall to the shadows

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
